capabilities: ingest open notes into wiki pages with guarded section patches
query the wiki and answer questions in the sidebar with cross-links
lint wiki pages for gaps, outdated content, and broken links
format open markdown notes without adding or removing facts
export domains as Google Open Knowledge Format bundles
extras: Not reviewed by Obsidian staff. Mobile supports only Query; Ingest, Lint, Init, Format, and Export OKF are desktop-only. local.json stores API keys and must be excluded from sync. Extensive performance reference and developer release-validation documentation included.
problem: Obsidian notes stay as loose files; keeping a structured, up-to-date reference wiki derived from them requires manual writing and maintenance.

relations.evidence: Supported transport: OpenAI-compatible, with local Ollama and remote services supported.

requires.name: Ollama (local) or a remote OpenAI-compatible service
API key for remote OpenAI-compatible services
remote OpenAI-compatible services may require payment

summary: AI wiki builder that reads your notes and maintains a structured local knowledge base using an OpenAI-compatible LLM such as local Ollama.
